governanceNotes: D1 batch 41 (2026-09-24): deferred on three independent grounds. (i) Zero-record for forward outcomes (camptodactyly batch 32, fissured-tongue batch 34 precedents): the targeted searches ('black hairy tongue halitosis association' returned only the Just-Sarobe smoking review; 'hairy tongue tongue coating malodor' returned only the Abbaszadeh tongue-coating frequency study) located no condition-specific cohort quantifying incident outcomes attributable to hairy tongue (lingua villosa nigra) itself - the filiform-papilla hypertrophy with retained keratin and pigment is a benign, self-limited finding that resolves with tongue hygiene and driver removal, and no downstream disease cohort exists in the located literature. (ii) Shared-driver guard: the Just-Sarobe 2008 review records that smoking is directly responsible for black hairy tongue and independently for halitosis, taste and smell disorders, and cosmetic oral changes - so the plausible halitosis or dysgeusia associations route through the shared smoking driver rather than an arrow from this finding (shared-driver guard; enophthalmos-to-diplopia pattern). The Abbaszadeh 2023 study documents tongue coating correlated with smoking and the simplified oral health index with an oral-malodor relationship, but it is a general coating study without hairy-tongue specificity - driver-mediated, not condition-specific. (iii) Wrong-identity guard: oral-hairy-leukoplakia is a distinct EBV-associated lateral-tongue lesion that must not be conflated with dorsal hairy tongue, and the fissured-tongue, geographic-tongue (benign-migratory-glossitis synonym), glossitis, atrophic-glossitis, and median-rhomboid-glossitis identities own their respective oral-dorsum windows (duplicate-scope; batch 34/37/39 deferral chain). Negative screens recorded: no oral-cancer edge (hairy tongue is not a premalignant lesion, unlike the oral-lichen-planus pathway; zero-record and wrong-identity guards); no dysphagia or oral-pain edge (asymptomatic finding, zero-record); no depression or social-anxiety edge (cosmetic concern without quantified mood cohorts; the halitosis batch-41 edge owns the odor-to-psychological pathway where odor exists). Reopening condition: a quantified cohort of incident outcomes attributable to hairy tongue as an independent entity, or governance reclassification of the identity.
